dialogues.jp:
なんだか、この一応寄ってみるっていうとこ
ろが俺らしいというか、俺らしくないという
か……。
dialogues.en:
Ina way, this was completely like me, and in another way,
completely out-of-character.
dialogues.text:
Ina way, this was completely like me, and in another way,
completely out-of-character.

dialogues.jp:
気にしないものは徹底的に気にしない。気にな
るものは、どうしても気になる。
dialogues.en:
The things I didn't care about, I completely shoved to the
side, compared to the things I did care about, regardless of
importance.
dialogues.text:
The things I didn't care about, I completely shoved to the
side, compared to the things I did care about, regardless of
importance.

dialogues.jp: ……たいていの人間が、そうか。
dialogues.en: ...Just like a normal human being.
dialogues.text: ...Just like a normal human being.

dialogues.jp:
つまり、俺は普通の人間だということで、あま
り余計なことは考えずに足を運べばいいという
訳だ。
dialogues.en:
And since that's what I am, I continued on my merry way, not
thinking too much.
dialogues.text:
And since that's what I am, I continued on my merry way, not
thinking too much.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、テスト期間中なのに、大変だな」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, given that it's the test period, should you
really be here?"
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, given that it's the test period, should you
really be here?"

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、月城は草の前にちょこんとしゃ
がんでいた。何をするでもなく、草をじっと見
ていた。
dialogues.en:
As usual, Tsukishiro was squatting in front of the plant,
doing nothing else but staring at it.
dialogues.text:
As usual, Tsukishiro was squatting in front of the plant,
doing nothing else but staring at it.

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に気づいた彼女は、
dialogues.en:
My words at least manage to wake her out of her trance, and
she replied,
dialogues.text:
My words at least manage to wake her out of her trance, and
she replied,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...It's okay."
dialogues.text: "...It's okay."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、草の方から視線を移動させることなく
そう返事をした。
dialogues.en: Without even movng her gaze from the plant, though.
dialogues.text: Without even movng her gaze from the plant, though.

dialogues.jp:
「成績がいいにしても、帰って勉強した方がい
　いんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en:
"You may be good at exams, but you should still go home and
study a bit..."
dialogues.text:
"You may be good at exams, but you should still go home and
study a bit..."

dialogues.jp:
何を人の心配をしているのだと、心の中で自分
を笑う。
dialogues.en:
Displaying my worries about her studies, I could only laugh
at myself inside.
dialogues.text:
Displaying my worries about her studies, I could only laugh
at myself inside.

dialogues.jp: 俺が、帰って勉強をしろよと。
dialogues.en: That's what I should be doing, instead.
dialogues.text: That's what I should be doing, instead.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、草の方を見たまま、首を横にふるふる
と振った。
dialogues.en:
Still keeping the plant in her line of sight, she shook her
head no.
dialogues.text:
Still keeping the plant in her line of sight, she shook her
head no.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大切だから」
dialogues.en: "...It's special."
dialogues.text: "...It's special."

dialogues.jp: 彼女はそこから動こうとしない。
dialogues.en: She showed no signs of movement whatsoever.
dialogues.text: She showed no signs of movement whatsoever.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、ずっと見てたって、すぐ花が咲く訳じゃ
　ないだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"But, just staring at it endlessly isn't going to help it
grow, right?"
dialogues.text:
"But, just staring at it endlessly isn't going to help it
grow, right?"

dialogues.jp: 月城がようやく俺の方を向く。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro finally turned to look at me.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro finally turned to look at me.

dialogues.jp: 「それに、ずーっと見てる訳でもないんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "And if so, then there's no reason to do so."
dialogues.text: "And if so, then there's no reason to do so."

dialogues.jp:
「雑草だって、毎日抜かなきゃいけないほど生
　える訳でもないしな」
dialogues.en:
"It's just a weed right now anyway, and it's not going to
live forever."
dialogues.text:
"It's just a weed right now anyway, and it's not going to
live forever."

dialogues.jp: 口に任せて、俺はべらべらとしゃべり立てた。
dialogues.en:
I let my mouth do the talking, deicding to just go wtih what
I felt without thinking.
dialogues.text:
I let my mouth do the talking, deicding to just go wtih what
I felt without thinking.

dialogues.jp: 「枯れちゃう時は、すんなり枯れちまう──」
dialogues.en: "And when it dies, it'd have did the best--"
dialogues.text: "And when it dies, it'd have did the best--"

dialogues.jp:
目の前に、ひどく悲しそうな顔をした月城がい
て、俺のことを見上げていた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro looked up at me, with a heartbreakingly-sad face.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro looked up at me, with a heartbreakingly-sad face.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: ".....Senpai."
dialogues.text: ".....Senpai."

dialogues.jp: 胸に抱いている人形をぎゅっと強く抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: She hugged her doll more tightly than I'd ever seen.
dialogues.text: She hugged her doll more tightly than I'd ever seen.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺は自分が何を言ったのか、ようやく
気づくのだった。
dialogues.en: Seeing that, I finally realized what I was saying.
dialogues.text: Seeing that, I finally realized what I was saying.

dialogues.jp: 「……悪ィ。つい、｛むご／酷｝いこと言っちゃったな」
dialogues.en: "...Sorry. I said a lot of terrible things."
dialogues.text: "...Sorry. I said a lot of terrible things."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、強く頭を左右に振った。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro shook her head left and right, far more fiercely
than I've ever seen.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro shook her head left and right, far more fiercely
than I've ever seen.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大切だから」
dialogues.en: "...It's special."
dialogues.text: "...It's special."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……この花は、大切だから」
dialogues.en: "...This flower is special, that's why..."
dialogues.text: "...This flower is special, that's why..."

dialogues.jp:
よく見ると、その大きな｛とびいろ／鳶色｝の瞳には、うっす
らと涙のようなものが溜っていた。
dialogues.en: Those big purple eyes were on the verge of tears.
dialogues.text: Those big purple eyes were on the verge of tears.

dialogues.jp:
「……悪ィ。そうだよな。月城が一生懸命育て
　る草だってのに、俺ってば」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry. Of course, it's the plant you took so much pains
to grow, how could I..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry. Of course, it's the plant you took so much pains
to grow, how could I..."

dialogues.jp:
月城がうつむき、表情が見えなくなる。そして、
また強く頭を左右に振り、俺の制服の袖をぎゅっ
と掴んだ。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro refused to face me, keeping her head bowed. With
yet another fierce shake of the head, she grabbed onto my
sleeve.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro refused to face me, keeping her head bowed. With
yet another fierce shake of the head, she grabbed onto my
sleeve.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大切な、だけ」
dialogues.en: "...it is... special."
dialogues.text: "...it is... special."

dialogues.jp:
もう一度、俺を見上げると、まるで何かに恐れ
るように走ってどこかへ行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
She looked up at me with fear in her eyes, then ran off
before I could say anymore.
dialogues.text:
She looked up at me with fear in her eyes, then ran off
before I could say anymore.

dialogues.jp: 袖に残る、月城の感覚。
dialogues.en: The feeling of her tiny hand remained on my sleeve.
dialogues.text: The feeling of her tiny hand remained on my sleeve.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いこと、したな……」
dialogues.en: "I really messed up this time..."
dialogues.text: "I really messed up this time..."

dialogues.jp: 余計な一言を言ってしまったと思う。
dialogues.en: I said far more than I should've.
dialogues.text: I said far more than I should've.

dialogues.jp:
あまりにおとなしい月城を少しは挑発できるか
と思ったけれど、どうにも失敗してしまったと
いう感じだ。
dialogues.en:
I thought it would provoke the normally reticient Tsukishiro
into a reaction, but it was a horrible failure.
dialogues.text:
I thought it would provoke the normally reticient Tsukishiro
into a reaction, but it was a horrible failure.

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きくため息をついた。
dialogues.en: I sighed deeply.
dialogues.text: I sighed deeply.

dialogues.jp:
やはり、今日の試験勉強は、気が乗りそうにな
い。
dialogues.en: No way I'd be in any mood to study now.
dialogues.text: No way I'd be in any mood to study now.

dialogues.jp: ◆月城の気持ち◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Special Thing◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Special Thing◆

dialogues.jp:
どうも気になっているようで、俺はまた体育館
裏に足を運んだ。
dialogues.en:
Before I knew it, I was instinctively walking to the back of
the gym.
dialogues.text:
Before I knew it, I was instinctively walking to the back of
the gym.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらずそこには月城がいて、草の世話をし
ていた。
dialogues.en: As usual, Tsukishiro was there, taking care of the plant.
dialogues.text: As usual, Tsukishiro was there, taking care of the plant.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城の真意が知りたくて、挑発してみた
のだけれど、月城はとても悲しそうな表情をし
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
Wanting to find out her real intentions, I tried to provoke
a reaction out of her, but all I succeeded in doing was make
her sad.
dialogues.text:
Wanting to find out her real intentions, I tried to provoke
a reaction out of her, but all I succeeded in doing was make
her sad.

dialogues.jp:
あの草は、俺が思っている以上に、彼女にとっ
て大切なモノだったらしい。
dialogues.en:
It seems that plant is even more important to her than I
thought.
dialogues.text:
It seems that plant is even more important to her than I
thought.
